construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

2022 version (H20-037): 21-story mixed residential and commercial building, about 721,286 sq ft in total: 194 residential units, 368,093 sq ft of office, 30,790 sq ft of commercial/retail, three levels of below-grade parking, on about 1.25 gross acres. City Council approved it on December 13, 2022, with certification of a Supplemental EIR (SCH 2003042127).

City permit H24-050 (filed 2024-08-26, status Approved, issue date 2025-12-17) allows either Option A, the 21-story building approved under H20-037, or Option B, two 27-28-story mixed residential and commercial buildings. Applicant: Project Fountain Alley LLC and Westbank Corp. The environmental folder for the 2020 permit is titled Westbank Energy Hub.
Westbank lists The Energy Hub in San Jose as in development: 730,000 sq ft of retail, rental residential and workspace, designed by Bjarke Ingels Group.
